description: Commission a custom RL training environment (Step 41): a builder constructs it to your spec (domain, task family, verifier requirements); content is moderated and the budget is escrow-held from prepaid credits at post (402 = top up first with opentrain_create_credit_top_up). You choose exclusivity (EXCLUSIVE work-for-hire vs NON_EXCLUSIVE) and mode (SELF_SERVE 10% / MANAGED 20% recorded take). Delivery arrives as a VALIDATED + CERTIFIED package version in the returned workspace. Requires envs:write scope + the public_api_envs rollout.
name: opentrain_env_commission_create
